name: ai-badger-query-pipeline
description: Delegate-planned multi-query RAG: the delegator persona plans concept-grouped queries via a direct model call, the bank is searched once per query, Jev scores the candidates, and a 5-slot document-aware merge is injected through mem-based-rag. pi discovers the entry as ~/.pi/agent/extensions/<name>/index.ts; this manifest records metadata only and does not register the entry.
